join.title: Use a join code
join.summary: Scan a QR code or enter your code

provision.title: Set up my VPS
provision.summary: Create a VPN on your own server

hetzner.title: Create a Hetzner server
hetzner.summary: Rent a new VPS that sets itself up

choice.advancedHint: Create a server with a Hetzner Cloud account

backup.title: Restore this device
backup.summary: Adds a server back to this device. The server itself isn’t contacted.
backup.fileHint: A .sirinvpn-backup file. Servers already on this device are never overwritten.

error.picker: Couldn’t open the file picker. Try again.
error.restore: Couldn’t restore the backup. Check the file and password.

invitation.trust: Join only if you expected this join code from someone you trust.
invitation.error: Couldn’t check this join code. Ask for a new one.

join.title: Join a server
join.summary: Your private key is created on this device and never leaves it.
join.codeHint: Keep it private, like a password
join.error: This join code didn’t work. It may have expired, been used or been cancelled; ask for a new one.

recover.title: Use a recovery key
recover.summary: Become this server’s Owner again on this device.
recover.keyHint: Starts with sirr1. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

file.loaded: Recovery key loaded from the file.
file.openError: Couldn’t open the recovery key file. Check the file and its password.

recover.confirmRevoke: Remove all previous Owner devices and use up this key. Other people keep access; Admins lose recovery permissions.
recover.replaceProfile: Replace this device’s saved profile for {{name}}
recover.error: Recovery didn’t finish. Try again with the same key.
recover.disconnectFirst: Disconnect the VPN first. Recovery can’t start while this device is connected.
recover.done: You’re the Owner of {{name}} again. Your old recovery key is used up, so create a new one in Keys & recovery.

setup.title: Connect your server
setup.summary: Sign in to your server over SSH to install SirinVPN.
setup.name: Server name

replace.title: Replace existing installation
replace.summary: Only if every Owner device and recovery key is lost

fingerprint.title: Verify your server
fingerprint.summary: Check this fingerprint in your hosting provider’s web console.
fingerprint.mismatch: If it doesn’t match, don’t continue. The connection may be intercepted.
fingerprint.replaceWarning: Replacing removes every device, join code and recovery key for this server.
fingerprint.pinned: SirinVPN created this key on this device and put it on the server before it first started, so there’s nothing to compare.
fingerprint.confirmed: You confirmed this fingerprint matches your server.

confirmReplace.title: Replace the existing installation?
confirmReplace.message: Every device, join code and recovery key for this server stops working. Other software on the server isn’t affected.

installing.title: Setting up your server
installing.summary: Installing SirinVPN on {{host}}. This usually takes a few minutes.
installing.keepOpen: Keep SirinVPN open until this finishes.
installing.stepChecked: Confirm the VPS identity and network
installing.stepInstallDetail: Connects, checks the server, uploads and verifies the software, then configures the VPN

success.title: Your VPN is ready
success.summary: {{name}} was added, and this device is its Owner.
success.recoverySummary: Only this device can manage the server. If you lose it, a recovery key is the only way back in. You can create one once you’re connected.

error.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the server over SSH. Check the address and port.
error.network: Couldn’t check the server’s network. Try again.

failed.title: Installation didn’t finish

change.unchanged: Nothing on the server was changed.
change.rolledBack: SirinVPN changed the server, then rolled those changes back.
change.unknown: SirinVPN couldn’t confirm whether the server was changed. Installing again checks the server first.

failed.signInAgain: The SSH password wasn’t kept. Go back to settings to enter it again.

created.title: {{name}} is ready
created.summary: It’s running at {{host}} with an SSH key this device created, so there’s nothing to verify. Install SirinVPN with the recommended settings, or review them first.

hetzner.title: Create a server on Hetzner Cloud
hetzner.summary: SirinVPN rents a Debian 13 server in your Hetzner account and installs itself. You never type an IP address or a password.
hetzner.tokenHint: In the Hetzner Console, open your project and create a Read & Write token under Security, then API tokens. It’s sent only to Hetzner and isn’t saved.
hetzner.tokenExpired: SirinVPN keeps the API token for only 10 minutes. Enter it again to continue.
hetzner.price: {{total}} per month: server {{server}} plus IPv4 address {{ipv4}}. Hetzner bills your account until you delete the server.
hetzner.priceNoIpv4: {{total}} per month for the server. Hetzner bills your account until you delete the server.

confirm.title: Create a Hetzner server?
confirm.message: {{type}} in {{location}} costs {{total}} a month until you delete it.

hetzner.waitingHint: This usually takes one or two minutes.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.message: {{name}}, its IP address and everything on it are removed from your Hetzner account. This can’t be undone.

hetzner.deleted: It’s gone from your Hetzner account, and Hetzner no longer bills you for it.
hetzner.failedSummary: The server exists in your Hetzner account and is billed until it’s deleted. Wait again, keep it to set it up later, or delete it.
hetzner.kept: Hetzner bills it until you delete it in the Hetzner Console. To set it up later, choose Set up my VPS and enter its address. Its SSH host key is below for checking.
hetzner.leaveWarning: A Hetzner server was created and is billed until it’s deleted. Leave anyway?
hetzner.billed: {{name}} is billed to your Hetzner account until it’s deleted.

uncertain.title: Hetzner may have created {{name}}
uncertain.summary: The answer from Hetzner didn’t arrive, so {{name}} may exist in your Hetzner account and be billed. Look for a server with this name in the Hetzner Console, or check from here. Creating another server stays off until this is settled.
uncertain.checkFailed: Couldn’t check whether the server exists. Look for it in the Hetzner Console.
uncertain.found: {{name}} exists in your Hetzner account. Set it up now, or delete it in the Hetzner Console.
uncertain.notFound: Hetzner doesn’t list {{name}} right now. If the Hetzner Console doesn’t show it either, it wasn’t created.

absentConfirm.title: {{name}} doesn’t exist?
absentConfirm.message: Confirm only after checking the Hetzner Console. If {{name}} exists, creating another server bills you for both.

uncertain.leaveWarning: Hetzner may have created {{name}}, which is billed until it’s deleted. Look for it in the Hetzner Console. Leave anyway?

port.reserved: SirinVPN uses port {{port}} on the server. Choose another.
port.sameAsDirect: Direct UDP already uses this port. Choose another.
port.sameAsQuic: QUIC answers on this UDP port, the same number as TCP/TLS. Choose another.
